//: The machine-checkable half of docs/limitations.md's '## Known divergences' section (chtypes#185). The prose is authored there; this file carries only what scripts/check-divergences.py can drive against loaded artifacts. Every '###' heading under that section must have exactly one entry here (by 'heading', matched verbatim, prefix stripped) and every entry here must match a heading — scripts/check-divergences.py's coverage check refuses either side existing alone. Each check's 'settings' are a compile-time profile (a type gate binds at compile, docs/guides/settings.md 'The one exception'); 'err_code' and 'err_msg' are asserted only where docs/limitations.md itself states them — a code without a quoted message means the page named the code alone. 'stored' asserts THIS LIBRARY's current answer for a row's stored text (BatchResult.rows[i].values[column].text) — it is expected to start FAILING the day a relink makes the library match the server, which is the retirement signal for that entry, not a regression. 'stored_same' asserts that several named rows all store IDENTICAL text for a column, with no fixed text of its own — the shape a value computed once (rather than per row or per insert) produces, for a value (a random DEFAULT's exact bytes) that is not reproducible across processes. A check's top-level 'batches' (default 1) drives its payload through its compiled schema that many times, concatenating rows across calls in order, to reproduce separate INSERTs rather than one larger one.

entries.heading: A DEFAULT over demangle admits what a real server refuses to create

checks.note: the divergence itself, on every line: allow_introspection_functions defaults to disabled, and a real server refuses the CREATE TABLE with 446 (FUNCTION_NOT_ALLOWED) at that default; this library never consults the setting, so it compiles the schema and stores demangle's answer regardless (server half measured by the artifact producer, not here)
checks.schema: s String, v String DEFAULT demangle(s)
